description: Selected second 13-class P39 wrapper registration/control pass, carrying the preceding membership state, energy objective, and rigid transform.

input_materialization.description: The committed float32 RAS NIfTI is assembled from the Java-matched second-pass class memberships and the unchanged atlas-space priors in the committed lesion13_next_gm_registration fixture. The focused test rebuilds it from state and asserts exact array/affine equality.
input_materialization.membership_state: Output of the finite synthetic 13-class next-thinning -> statistics -> GM-enabled membership pass.
input_materialization.geometry: Identity affine in RAS, matching the preceding synthetic registration grid.

source_call_order: transform atlas priors using the second registerShapes transform/bounds

registration_state.initial_transform: The transform returned by the immediately preceding synthetic registerShapes call.

over_unit_rotation_regression.trial: second registration, first optimizer iteration, third line-search candidate
over_unit_rotation_regression.purpose: Pins Java float accumulation for the rotation-vector norm before Math.sqrt and the resulting mapped coordinate.

reference_fields: initial energy, gradient, and diagonal Hessian
candidate transforms, energy, source acceptance/rejection, and iteration values
final transform, rotation, and all class bounds

control_state.expected: iteration-limit stop after registration, without growing

alternate_no_stop_branch.expected: finite energy ratio passes the zero threshold; nonterminal iteration grows from the second thinning output and refreshes relations
alternate_no_stop_branch.next_loop: The refreshed branch state plus atlas priors resampled using this registration's returned transform and bounds enter one source-matched propagateThinning pass, followed by the selected 13-class statistics and GM-enabled membership/energy refresh.

java_reference.kind: Hand-coded selected Java formula excerpt using the pinned upstream ParametricTransform, RotationMatrix, ImageFunctions, and Numerics sources; not execution of the full wrapper/class.

scope_limitations: The synthetic state covers the selected second registration, its terminal wrapper control, and an alternate finite no-stop continuation through growth, relation refresh, atlas-prior transform, one following thinning pass, the subsequent selected statistics and GM-enabled membership/energy refresh; it is not complete LesionTOADS equivalence.
The tested synthetic memberships remain finite under the selected variance conditions; this fixture does not cover every source zero-variance NaN case.
Atlas priors remain separate from transformed membership priors, and this case does not validate real atlas alignment or real imaging data.
